name: dsh-profile-lock-proof
description: Verify a DSH profile's declared, locked and installed plugin closure without returning source contents.

interface.shortDescription: Prove profile, lock and installed bundles agree.
interface.longDescription: Verify a pinned DSH profile declaration, pnpm lock importer, installed package manifests and bundle patch hashes, then emit a content-addressed proof without returning source contents.
defaultPrompt: Verify this DSH profile lock proof and show any closure gaps.
